note: Regional park at Wynyard's west entrance, 2.5 km south of the Yellowhead Highway on Grid 640, quiet and well treed; its reservoir, behind the old CPR dam, is aerated and holds rainbow trout (canoes, kayaks and electric-powered boats are allowed; fishing needs a provincial licence).  Campers have barbecues and free firewood; drinking water is at a coin-operated station at the Town Shop in Wynyard.  There is no full-time attendant: the facilities are cleaned and restocked once a day.  The trails stay open all year. --Claude
